general.notes: Passive Twinax Direct Attach Cable (DAC); not an optical transceiver. Cable length 0.5 to 5 m (1.6 to 16.4 ft); AWG30 for 0.5–2 m variants, AWG26 for 3–5 m. FEC required in host per IEEE 802.3bj; without FEC BER stated as less than 5 x 10^-5. Storage temperature -40°C to +85°C. 2-wire management interface per SFF-8436.
provenance_datasheet_sections: QSFP28, 100GBase, Direct Attach Cable (DAC), AWG30, 0.5 to 5m, passive
